c23151007.reason: room-function label ('COZINHA / CUISINE / KITCHEN') inside the Tarrafal camp museum; not a name a map would contain

c105219734.notes: Stack of four white arrow-shaped direction signs at a junction on Sal; the signs are small in a tall frame with lots of sky. 'do' in 'Pedra do Lume' is in small type; the last sign has an airplane pictogram. The map usually spells the village 'Pedra de Lume'.

c120181229.notes: Carved wooden board on a green mesh gate at the eco-park in Sal. The opening-hours plaque and no-dogs pictogram below are left out. Bougainvillea leaves overlap the right edge without hiding text.

c20041197.notes: Sun-bleached UNESCO candidacy board in Cape Verdean Creole (ALUPEC spelling, ISO 639-3 'kea'). Faint repeated background text ('CIDADE VELHA', other heritage cities) and a torn lower-left corner; the slogan at the bottom ('...DI NÓS TUDU!') is partly missing and left out.

c72806609.notes: Large white 3D letters on a road median in Assomada, slightly blurred and at an angle; the letters sit close together with no clear gap between words. 'CVTelecom' and 'Medicalia' signs on the building behind are distractors.

c128926030.notes: 'I [red heart] SOMADA' 3D letters on a roadside rock cut at the entry to Assomada (Creole 'Somada'); the heart is a symbol, not a letter. Hazy light; a tiny plate to the right of the letters is unreadable.

c88123684.notes: Tourist direction panel with brown/white/blue rows, pictograms and up arrows, Porto Novo (Santo Antão). Sun glare washes the top row. The small 'CABO VERDE Santo Antão' logo text at the bottom is left out; 'Porto Novo' is in small type at the bottom right.

c15908490.notes: Three arrow-shaped direction signs at a cobbled junction in Rabil, Boa Vista, shot through a vehicle window (light streaks and reflections). 'de' in 'praia de Chaves' is small; the brown sign has a beach pictogram.

c104754659.reason: novelty signpost giving distances to distant countries and islands (Canarias, Dakar, Tailandia, Portugal); not local place signage

c18165871.reason: event banner ('TARRAFAL Simpósio Internacional 28 Abril > 1 Maio') over the camp gate; event photo, with two people in the archway

c71804792.reason: price painted on a car for sale; no place sign

c125073994.reason: hand-painted 'CAMINHO ANTIGO' trail marking on wall stones; generic, not a named place

c33546927.notes: Small rectangular name sign half-buried in a sand dune on Boa Vista, tilted and partly crossed by dry branches; the lower right corner is chipped.

c14825754.notes: Rusty-edged beach name sign on two posts, Boa Vista. Scratched graffiti (names, dates) and two stickers around the name are distractors.

c125073997.notes: Wooden hiking fingerpost (trail PR 1, red 'PR 1 SARG' tags on both arms) on the Santo Antão coast path; text is small relative to the frame. Hiker pictograms and yellow/red trail marks are not transcribed.

c125073996.reason: only a yellow/red trail paint mark on a rock; no text

c18165851.notes: Large Ministério da Cultura site board with a plan of the camp and a numbered legend (LEGENDA 1-25: ADMINISTRAÇÃO/DIRECTOR, TORRES DE VIGIA, ...); only the title lines are the target. The sign says 'DE TARRAFAL'; the site is usually mapped as 'Campo de Concentração do Tarrafal'.

c14781560.notes: Heavily rusted beach sign on Boa Vista. The initial 'P' of 'Praia' is rusted away and left out, rust blotches cross 'Varandinha' and 'Bracona', and the top-left corner is eaten through.

c125073995.notes: Single wooden hiking fingerpost (trail PR 2) on Santo Antão, shot from below; red 'PR 2 SARG' tag at the left end, small hiker pictogram and trail colours at the arrow tip.

c15908520.notes: Town exit sign with a red diagonal bar crossing the text ('Come back soon to Rabil'), Boa Vista. Traffic signs and a cluster of direction signs in the background are distractors.
